## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `refactor:`, `test:`, `chore:`, `ci:`)
- [ ] The branch is `feature/…`, `fix/…` or `chore/…` and targets `main` (squash merge)
- [ ] The build has no new warnings and all tests pass; new code has tests and coverage stays at 70% or more
- [ ] `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md` and the affected docs are updated
- [ ] No secrets, except in `appsettings.*.json` with a `// TODO(vault)` comment; no personal data or commercially licensed packages
